C1198.title: Unauthorized AI-Generated Celebrity Impersonation in Livestream Sales Disrupts Online Order, Leads to Administrative Penalty
C1198.summary: The cybersecurity division in Datong, Shanxi, discovered that a local resident, Xing, used AI tools without authorization to create a digital persona resembling Cheng Li-wen, chairperson of the Kuomintang, for livestream sales. The conduct triggered public concern and seriously disrupted normal online order. Public security authorities determined that the conduct disrupted online order and imposed an administrative penalty; Shanxi police later published it as a typical AI-tool rumor case.
